Introduction

Hello, for those who don't know me I am Louis Appleyard, I'm a Durham University student studying Computer Science and I now have a little blogging website I can work on.

Why have I made a website?

I have a few reasons for why I made this website:

* To have some sort of project to work on * To write about things I am interested in * And to discuss academic things I may want to write about that might not be worth publishing

What kind of things will I write about?

At the moment the things I have cooking that I'm hoping to write about include:

* Animation as a medium and how it has been infantilised * The usage of AI and its environmental impact * Further AI ethical questions * Universal basic income and how it could be implemented * Other left wing economic ideas

Conclusion

So yeah, this will be quite casual for the time being but perhaps things will change over time... let's wait and see!
